comments.author: Li Yue
comments.body:
If one of the colony cities named above matches that "Central Capital" status, then yes, you should be able to get the map from its archives.

Quote some other folks on this site:

Central Capital is reached after the 3 fields (culture, trade and maritime)exceeds 40k

to see actual values, try to present a discovery to city official, or donate to shopkeeper. in that new window actual points are displayed.
